# Gator Alley Dog Training

> Dog training in Parrish, FL (Manatee County), serving Palmetto, Ellenton, Bradenton, Lakewood Ranch and Sarasota.
> Personally led by Jacob Soos in a real home environment, not a kennel. Board-and-train programs for puppies and adult dogs,
> plus live one-on-one virtual coaching over Zoom.

## Programs
- Puppy Head Start Program: https://gatoralleyk9.com/puppy-head-start
- Basic Obedience: https://gatoralleyk9.com/basic-obedience
- Advanced Obedience, Off-Leash & Behavior Modification: https://gatoralleyk9.com/behavioral-issues-reactivity
- Puppy Raise & Train: https://gatoralleyk9.com/puppy-foundations
